key_terms.يُرَاءُونَ: They show off; they perform deeds to be seen by people

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be among those who 'dissimulate' or show off in worship?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase characterizes the hypocrites (munafiqun) who perform obligatory acts like prayer and charity with ostentation to gain social status, thereby nullifying their spiritual reward. Scholars emphasize that riya' is the subtle corruption of sincerity (ikhlas), turning worship into a transaction for worldly praise rather than divine pleasure. This concept is central to understanding the internal state of the believer, as highlighted in the hadith of Imam Ali regarding the 'disease of the heart.'
